name: Sandeep Nailwal
description: Sandeep Nailwal is the founder of Polygon  and CEO of the Polygon Foundation. He leads Polygon’s vision to build the Open Money Stack, enabling seamless onchain payments and financial activity. Since co-founding Matic Network in 2017, he has helped scale Ethereum and advance blockchain adoption. He also founded Blockchain for Impact and the Nailwal Fellowship, supporting medical research and Web3 builders. He holds an MBA from IIM Mumbai.
